svg.aria-label: BeagleBone Black sheet 1 schematic: altiumts source on left, Circuit JSON on right

g.text: NOTE: PCB Revision for this board is Rev B4.

text.tspan: On the initial production release the processors were to be found incorrect as
supplied by TI.
Parts while marked AM3359 were actually AM3352. This revision uses the correct parts.
1. Deleted R29-R44 from the LCD lines.
2. Added 47pf capacitors C156-C173 to LCD data lines to ground.
3. Changed schematic revision to A5A.
4. Changed a few footprints after PCB update for above changes.
5. Added access point for the battery function of the TPS65217C.
6. Added Ferrite beads in series with LED power and 5V power rail of the USB host
connector. Required to pass
FCC/CE testing due to noise emissions on that pin.
7. Added power button to enable sleep, wakeup, power down and power up features on the
system.
8. Added Modification to add 100K ohm resistor to ground to prvent crosstalk when serial
cable is not plugged in.
1. Added 100K pulldown on J1 pin 4 to prvent crosstalk when serial cable is not connected
into PCB layout.
